correctness.rationale: Sufficiency follows by translating an arbitrary covering partition through a matching. Necessity: any Hall obstruction is either a source with no target or both sources with only the same target. Explicit 3-ary product-grid teams satisfy source splitting and bound the largest respective target-FD subteams by 1/3+1/3 or 1/2+1/3, strictly less than 1. The proof handles empty determinants, repeated source/target FDs, arbitrary determinant cardinality, and finite/infinite domain entailment. Standalone checker verified 131 constructed finite counterteams; finite tests are ancillary.
